$comment: The route the player reported as overlevelled, and the measurement agreed. Grass here ran 8-13 while Route 1 grass tops out at 5, so the step across one route sign was +8 levels at the top of the band and +6.3 on the average roll -- by far the steepest boundary in the game. tests/helpers/simulate.mjs was extended to work out where the player actually IS rather than guessing: a player raising a team arrives here at level NINE, against a band averaging 10.1 and reaching 13. That is the "a couple levels or so" in the bug report, measured. Route 1 is left exactly as the previous pass tuned it and Route 2 comes down to meet it instead: bands are narrowed as well as lowered, because a wide band is what produces the one encounter three levels over your head. Average roll 10.1 -> 7.6, top 13 -> 10. A solo starter at the arrival level went from 46/33 percent of fights won to 71/60.
